title: Application Fee Refund and Closing Credit Terms by Program — Mortgage Loan File
content:
These program terms state, for each Mortgage Loan File program, whether a collected application fee is refunded when Larkspur denies the file, how many business days after the fee's entry date a borrower withdrawal earns a full refund, and whether the fee is credited back on the Closing Disclosure at consummation.

| Program | Refunded when Larkspur denies the file | Withdrawal refund window (business days after the fee entry date) | Credited back on the Closing Disclosure at consummation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | yes | 3 | yes |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | yes | 3 | yes |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | yes | 3 | yes |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | yes | 3 | yes |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | yes | 3 | yes |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | yes | 3 | yes |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | yes | 3 | no |

The Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed program is the one program whose collected application fee is not credited back at consummation; under it the fee stays paid. Denial refunds and the 3-business-day withdrawal window apply under every program.
